experiments.question: Do exact local elliptic logarithms at both primes of K above 11 yield the documented rank-three coefficient kernel modulo 11^4?
experiments.decisive_observation: PARI/GP and rational/projective arithmetic independently yield all twelve residues and the unit determinant modulo 11.
dependencies: This is a coefficient-module kernel, not a Selmer or global height kernel
experiments.negative_control: Mutate a local-log residue by one; an old kernel vector must cease to satisfy the row condition.
experiments.stop_condition: Do not infer a global derived-height radical unless an independently constructed global height pairing is actually calculated.

cross_disciplines.mechanism: Finite congruence matrix acts like a parity-check map on a coefficient module.
cross_disciplines.proof_boundary: This finite map is not the Galois cohomology localization defining Selmer.

cross_disciplines.mechanism: Identifiability requires distinguishing a measured logarithm map from an unobserved height pairing.
cross_disciplines.proof_boundary: A toy height with the same dimension is not the actual derived height.

experiments.question: Does a fully bounded exponential-integral sum, under the modular L-function identity and correct coefficients, enclose L'(E^-7,1) strictly above zero?
experiments.decisive_observation: Independent rational interval produces a positive lower bound; independent PARI coefficient oracle and numerical derivative provide separate cross-checks.
dependencies: Correct all a_n of original E and quadratic character
Mellin functional-equation derivative identity and normalization
Provably enclosing E1 and complete tail bound; ability to audit every source
experiments.negative_control: Deliberately corrupt an exponential-tail exponent or a Fourier coefficient; the checked equality/positivity preconditions must reject it.
experiments.stop_condition: Do not publish a theorem of analytic nonvanishing before Mellin identity, local Euler factors, coefficient oracle, and tail bounds are independently audited.
nonclaims: Numerical PARI is not an interval proof
No conclusion that the 11-primary Sha vanishes

cross_disciplines.mechanism: Outward rational enclosures of every finite term and the infinite tail.
cross_disciplines.proof_boundary: Valid enclosures do not verify the assumed analytic identity.

cross_disciplines.mechanism: Orthogonal assay: modular-form coefficients from PARI versus independently derived coefficient recursion.
cross_disciplines.proof_boundary: Shared mathematical identities remain independent proof obligations.

experiments.question: Can the rank-four E/Q and its -7 twist each be given certified 11-Selmer upper bounds 4 and 1?
experiments.decisive_observation: A mathematically complete global H1/local Kummer presentation gives F11-ranks bounded separately by 4 and 1.
dependencies: Odd-prime quadratic Galois descent and local Kummer compatibility
Global cohomology presentation must be complete
All places including 2,7,11,117223 and infinity must be handled
experiments.negative_control: Remove a required local Kummer condition; test must detect that any alleged 11-Selmer upper bound is then unjustified.
experiments.stop_condition: If finite global H1 generators or local conditions cannot be certified, report an open obstruction; do not substitute local logarithm rank.

cross_disciplines.mechanism: Odd-prime idempotents (1±sigma)/2 split Galois cohomology and classical Selmer conditions over a quadratic field.
cross_disciplines.proof_boundary: Requires a proof of compatibility with local Kummer subspaces, not just modular matrix projectors.
